#+title: Synthetic complete CRM exports

All names, ids, addresses and attachment bytes here are invented test data.
No vendor account, production export or network access is required.

Each vendor directory has one CSV per supported module and a manifest with
explicit column maps. The manifests intentionally exercise the same business
scenario with different vendor header conventions. They are mapped exports,
not evidence that every vendor exposes every module in one stock export.

The fixture includes one record per module, one supplier, one mapped custom
installation (a case), typed custom attributes, one original stage event and
three attachments (on a contact, a note and an email). The base manifest uses
draft quotes, sales orders and invoices. The historical manifest adds original
states, dates, closed deals and a payment.

The test supplies an existing venture and proposal stage id at runtime.
For a manual import, set venture_id and stage_map.proposal to corresponding
ids in a disposable destination organization before running venturectl crm.
owner_map maps an exported synthetic user to a historical operator label;
no login or membership is created.

Salesforce price book reference headers follow its documented PricebookEntry
fields: [[https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000384199&language=en_US&type=1][Salesforce Data Loader price book guidance]].
Additional columns always remain explicit in each manifest because export
labels and enabled modules differ across installations.

For =history-manifest.json=, supply =stage_map.won=, =stage_map.lost= and
=loss_reason_id= as well. It imports original dated open/won/lost deals,
accepted quotes, fulfilled orders and a paid invoice with =payments.csv=.
All identities and financial amounts are invented.
